column3: In this Act –
“Minister”  means  the  Minister  to  whom  the
subject of Higher Education is assigned.
“Accreditation”  means  the  granting  of  official
recognition  to  a  Higher  Educational
Institution  or  for  a  specific  academic
programme conducted by such Institution,
leading to the award of certificate, diploma,
degree or any other qualification, certifying
that institution or programme meet required
expected  standard  and  quality;
“Higher  Education”  means  any  academic  study
course  or  other  studies  beyond  the  upper-
secondary  level  provided  in  conventional,
open  and  distance  learning  modes  or
blended  modes  of  learning,  leading  to  the
award  of  any  certificate,  diploma,  degree,
any  other  higher  qualification  or  an
equivalent  thereof;
“Higher Educational Institution” means  an entity
defined under the definition of expression
“Higher Educational Institution” in section
147 of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978,
or Higher Educational Institutes, Centre for
Higher Learning established under section
24A  of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978,
